en: Baguio City is cooler than Manila because it is located at a higher elevation in the Cordillera mountains.
The volcanic soil in the Bicol Region makes it highly fertile for growing abaca plants.
The Philippines produces a significant amount of nickel laterite ore from open-pit mines in Surigao.
The Underground River in Palawan features a complex karst landscape where water cycles through underground limestone caves.
NASA's Curiosity rover explored the Gale Crater on Mars to search for signs of ancient microbial life.
Polaris, also known as the North Star, is located almost directly above Earth's northern rotational axis.
The Mare Tranquillitatis, or Sea of Tranquility, is the lunar basin where Apollo 11 astronauts first landed.
Mount Pinatubo's massive 1991 eruption injected millions of tons of sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere, cooling global temperatures.
The typhoon locally named Yolanda, internationally known as Haiyan, struck the Philippines in 2013 with extreme wind speeds.
The Amazon Rainforest experiences a tropical rainforest climate characterized by heavy rainfall every month of the year.
The Chocolate Hills in Bohol are formed from weathered marine limestone resting on an impermeable clay layer.
Jupiter's moon Europa has a smooth icy crust that scientists believe hides a massive liquid water ocean underneath.
